results.title: login: wrong password shows an error; right password reaches the dashboard; logout returns to a public page
first run: intro → onboarding → create account → dashboard
forgot password: the reset sheet opens from the login screen
results.detail: the recovery step is Google verification (not testable without a Google account); the e-mail code API is covered by docs/security-audit-r2.md

results.title: live workout: start, swap an exercise and undo, exit and resume, tick every set, finish; the workout is saved once
nutrition: free text logs a meal, an unknown food is refused with a clear message, a logged meal can be deleted
daily menu loads, a meal can be swapped, PDF export opens a printable page
sleep: log 5 h → the workout tab offers the sleep suggestion; double-click on save logs one night
journey tabs (progress / badges / goals) open without errors
settings: equipment, notifications, accessibility and body-data screens open; theme and language switch applies
security screen: no "two-factor auth" toggle (it was a local flag that protected nothing)
privacy & data: reset empties the data; delete removes the account (login fails afterwards)
expired token → the app sends the user to a public page instead of a broken dashboard
offline: a failed request shows a message and the app stays usable (no uncaught error)
slow server (Render waking up): the app shows a loading state, not a blank screen, and recovers
